purpose: Static contract checks for the Scopeify client. Scientific search, SOW quality, and model behavior are evaluated in the private backend repository.

agents.role: Checks source coverage and separation of the SOW from its search appendix.
Checks the client-facing SOW structure, estimate, deliverables, and consultation action.
Checks bounded local schema inspection and value-redaction contracts.
Checks document rendering, theme integration, responsive behavior, and accessibility.
Checks progress, recovery, and truthful output states.
Checks that promised client workflow components are implemented rather than labeled as future work.

cases.query: Render a preliminary Statement of Work.
cases.expected_decision: SOW is the default document and includes dates, phases, hours, assumptions, exclusions, and deliverables.

cases.query: Keep search evidence outside the client-facing SOW.
cases.expected_decision: Dataset inventory and search audit are on a separate document tab.

cases.query: Search supported literature and sequence archives.
cases.expected_decision: The live request includes PubMed, GEO, SRA, ENA, GSA/CNSA, and bioRxiv.

cases.query: Inspect arbitrary local table fields without transmitting cell values.
cases.expected_decision: Only schema labels, derived counts, inferred roles, and risk flags are sent.

cases.query: Inspect common tabular formats in the browser.
cases.expected_decision: CSV, TSV, semicolon, pipe, JSON, JSON Lines, XLSX, XLS, XLSM, and ODS structures are bounded and parsed.

cases.query: Select an H5AD, RDS, Parquet, or Feather file.
cases.expected_decision: Unsupported binary formats are metadata-only and require format-specific review.
A formula-neutralized XLSX workbook contains estimate, inventory, audit, and schema tabs.

cases.query: Recover from a transient backend or interrupted job.
cases.expected_decision: POST retries are idempotent and one fresh recovery job is attempted.
No unrelated static report or evidence is shown as a live result.
must_find_terms: No draft or inventory is available
No estimate is issued until the request completes

cases.query: Navigate the generated documents without a pointer.
cases.expected_decision: Tabs expose ARIA relationships and support arrow, Home, and End keys.

cases.query: Move from preliminary scope to a human-reviewed quote.
cases.expected_decision: A consultation action remains visible next to the downloadable workbook.
